1 
 
Focus on Jesus – belf of truth (v.14) 
 “I am the Truth.”  (John 14:6) 
 Authenticity, integrity, openness in your life 
 
 
 
 
Keep your relationships right – breastplate of righteousness (v.14) 
 Keep short accounts with God 
 Ask forgiveness from God and others 
 
2 
3 
 
Get Involved in service – boots of the gospel of peace (v.15) 
 The readiness to speak of Christ (Isaiah 52:7-10) 
 
 
 
 
Trust God in Difficult times – shield of faith (v.16) 
 The devil with challenge us with doubt, fear, anxiety, lust… 
 Keep trusting, don’t give up on your faith 
 
4 
5 
 
Keep the battle of the mind – helmet of salvation (v.17) 
 Salvation = freedom 
 Protect your mind: temptation starts 
 with a thought, which leads to action 
 
 
 
 
Know your Bible – sword of the Spirit (V.17) 
 Soak yourself in the Word of God 
 The only offensive piece of armor (Hebrews 4:12)
